pit_profile.why: Commodity exposure (Targa Resources Corp. FY2011 10-K): The Partnership’s primary natural gas gathering and processing arrangements that expose it to commodity price risk are its percent-of-proceeds arrangements. Distribution policy: 'even if the Partnership’s business experiences fluctuations in its cash from operations due to seasonal and cyclical factors' (the boilerplate of the cash distribution policy, not a statement that the business is cyclical: the CHTR reading). Risk factor: 'Our cash flow is dependent upon the ability of the Partnership to make cash distributions to us.'; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY11-FY11 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.2-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (no FY11-FY11 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY11: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: TRGP (retrospective, 2012-03-23) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.22x (33.9% downside to Bear $30 / +27.7% upside to Bull $58) | Adj composite 3.25 vs market 3.14: gap +0.11 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $33 (44x FY12E $0.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: +19.9% total (+10.0%/yr) | At 61.4x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $60 sits above the BULL case; Gathering and Processing +37.2% and Logistics and Marketing +8.6% operating margin in Q4 2011, forward revenues +26.6% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2011 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date; none has dated evidence.
